visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a white background and a title in blue Traditional Chinese text. A simple 2D hand-drawn character, appearing as a white dog-like creature with glasses and a hat, stands in the center and speaks. The drawing style is minimalist, using black ink lines on a plain white canvas. (2) As the narration progresses, the character's facial expressions change from neutral to wide-eyed and expressive. He gestures with his simplified paws to illustrate his story. Graphic icons representing a house with a 'For Rent' sign and a stack of money appear next to him to visualize his first experience renting. (3) The scene shifts to depict his first job at a bank. He is drawn with a small 'LV.01' label, while a grumpy-looking man with a cigarette and an 'LV.81' label represents his senior colleague. The background remains white, focusing entirely on the character interactions and text labels. (4) The character is shown standing on top of a small, rectangular room-box labeled '4800/Month', representing his small studio apartment. Question marks and the word 'Why' appear in a variety-show style to emphasize his confusion about his past decisions. (5) A diagram with arrows appears, showing a cyclical routine between the bank, his studio, and his home. The character moves along the arrows, visualizing his daily flow. Distractions at home are depicted through small vignettes: a television screen, an open refrigerator, and his family offering fruit at a table. (6) The character is shown working intensely in his studio. A large stack of cash with the number '18000' illustrates his salary, with an arrow pointing to how much goes to rent. He is shown painting on a canvas with a paintbrush, wearing a beret. (7) A comedic sequence follows where he describes his small fridge. He is shown placing books inside the fridge rather than food, indicating it is unplugged to save electricity. The character's face is drawn with a smug, proud expression. (8) He is shown running towards a 'FamilyMart' convenience store, which he calls his 'refrigerator'. A detailed drawing of a 'Chun Cui He' milk tea carton appears with a price tag of '25'. (9) The tone shifts as raindrops are drawn falling from the ceiling of his room, and a cartoon ghost character with a smile appears above his head, representing the 'ghost house' upstairs. His eyes are drawn large and watery to show distress. (10) The final scene shows the character intensely searching on a laptop. Images of website interfaces with listing descriptions scroll by. He looks frustrated until a lightbulb icon appears over his head, and he meets a character representing a real estate agent, leading into a cliffhanger.
